name: csvq
description: csvq — SQL-like query engine for CSV files. Query, join, and transform CSV data using familiar SQL syntax.

install_steps: curl -LO https://github.com/mithrandie/csvq/releases/download/v1.18.1/csvq-v1.18.1-linux-amd64.tar.gz && tar xzf csvq-v1.18.1-linux-amd64.tar.gz && sudo mv csvq /usr/local/bin/ && rm csvq-v1.18.1-linux-amd64.tar.gz
install_guidance.note: Binary from GitHub releases or package manager.

commands.description: csvq — SQL-like query engine for CSV files. Query, join, and transform CSV data using familiar SQL syntax.
